'''''Reveille''''' was the personal [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. Selecting [[Syal Antilles]] as his personal pilot, he used it to travel to [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] in an attempt to negotiate with the [[New Jedi Order]]. While there, he was taken captive and his shuttle, piloted by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], was used to infiltrate the [[Anakin Solo (starship)|''Anakin Solo'']].
